decision_conditions: The removal of deadwood, dangerous / hanging branches and ivy:  This does not require the formal consent of the Council.

Statutory crown lifting of trees: This does not require formal consent of the Council if the clearance only involves the removal of branches to give a separation between the footway and the tips of the lowest branches by up to 2.3m or the carriageway by up to 5.2m.

The early mature Acacia tree is situated in the rear pub garden. It is in a fair condition and can be seen by a variety of neighbours and surrounding roads. For these reasons it has a high amenity value.

Removing this tree will remove the amenity it provides. This species often has included bark, disguising itself as a split, that can be mitigated by reducing the tree. This would allow the tree to continue to provide amenity.
description: To fell 1x Acacia T1 on TPO 181
